productOnPage.title: The Classics Collection: Volume 2
productOnPage.author: Various
productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Discover friendship, bravery, courage and adventure in this collection of classics, retold by Yoto. The perfect collection for introducing your little one to literary classics.   Adapted by Yoto, these timeless novels have been brought to life for a new generation with music, sound effects, and a dynamic cast. From locked gardens to swashbuckling duels and tales of friendship, heart, and resilience, the whole family can indulge in these beloved stories that have stood the test of time.     Include in this pack: Oliver Twist The Three Musketeers The Secret Garden The Wind in the Willows Anne of Green Gables   ﻿Produced by Yoto with ID Audio. Tracks included: Introduction Chapter 1: The River Bank Chapter 2: The Open Road Chapter 3: The Wild Wood Chapter 4: Christmas at Mole End Chapter 5: Mr Toad Chapter 6: Toad's Adventures Chapter 7: The Further Adventures of Toad Chapter 8: Bad News for Mr Toad Chapter 9: The Battle for Toad Hall

#### Who are Creators on Yoto?

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.

[Explore the Creators Collection](/creators/)

[Read Creator biographies](https://yoto.space/creator-profiles)
